# Section 0: Current Positions & Hypotheses

**Book snapshot (default ••••770):** Cash $126.6K (119.7% of account — short book funds it) · account value $105.7K · equities −$56.5K net short · long options $35.7K · net delta ≈ −133% · gross delta leverage 3.1× · premium at risk 33.7% · theta ≈ −0.30%/day. Agentic ••••605 remains empty.
**Model risk appetite:** Last reading GPT 6/10 (Risk-on) · Grok 4/10 (Neutral) · Fable 8/10 (Risk-on). Today's engine refresh pending (grok-risk-daily runs separately).
**Overnight book changes:** **Short book tripled in size** — DASH −50→−150 sh with puts 7→14×; LYV −70→−100 sh; TOST token −1→−100 sh (now a real short). **AVAV sized** 1→30 sh. **MOS onboarded** (10× Sep 4 $24 calls + 1 sh). **BRBR fully closed** (calls + tracker gone). ## 1. DASH — local-commerce multiple (hold short, triple-sized + puts doubled)

**Price:** $222.36 close / $223.87 pre-market (+0.7%) | RSI(14): 69.2 | MACD histogram: +0.65
**Valuation:** Market cap $96.3B | PE 116.8× | P/B 9.7× | 52w range $143.30–$285.50
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 18 ref / 52W high):** Bear $146.60 | Base $215.79 | Bull $281.74
**Thesis (short):** Q2 revenue beat is digested; the position bets 117× earnings prices in perfection while regulation, insurance, and autonomy spend compress margins.
**Holdings:** Short **150 sh** @ $220.23 (was 50) + **14×** Jan '27 $200 puts @ $13.76 (mark $13.13, IV 44.7%, delta −0.29, break-even $186.87) — puts doubled 7→14 overnight.
**Latest:** Stocktwits: "breakout relief as earnings loom, ad growth in focus" (Aug 21); simplywall.st on back-to-school retail delivery partnerships (Aug 21). Bull tape remains loud.
**Catalyst:** Q3 earnings — Nov 4 (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch (short risk):** Strongest momentum chart in the book (RSI 69, MACD +0.65) and still climbing pre-market. Upside ref $281.74 = −26% against the short; $200 put strike is the hard floor. This is now the **dominant risk slot** (≈117% delta exposure / 49% capital).
**Action:** Hold — size is the thesis expression; respect the momentum, the doubled puts are the respect. Do not add into RSI 69 strength.

![DASH MACD](charts/2026-08-21/dash-macd.png)

## 2. LYV — live-events cycle (hold short, sized to 100 + put floor)

**Price:** $182.02 close / $181.90 pre-market (flat) | RSI(14): 50.4 | MACD histogram: −0.32
**Valuation:** Market cap $42.9B | PE n/m (loss) | 52w range $125.34–$189.25 (high Aug 14)
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 18 ref / 52W high):** Bear $125.61 | Base $180.74 | Bull $188.46
**Thesis (short):** Record ticket sales ran the stock to a fresh 52-week high; demand normalization and legal/capital intensity catch up before deferred revenue fully converts.
**Holdings:** Short **100 sh** @ $182.41 (was 70) + 12× Jan '27 $165 puts @ $6.05 (mark $6.05, IV 31.3%, delta −0.25, break-even $158.95).
**Latest:** Yahoo Finance: "could be 10% undervalued following pullback" (Aug 21) — bull case is back; Wealthfront + Danske disclosed new stakes (Aug 21); StockStory still flags inflated-stock risk (Aug 19).
**Catalyst:** Q3 earnings — early Nov (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch (short risk):** Only **4.0% under the fresh 52W high** ($189.25). RSI 50 + negative MACD = momentum cooling, not broken. Downside ref $125.61 is +31% for the short.
**Action:** Hold — put floor defines the fight ($165–189 zone); do not chase adds near the high.

![LYV RSI](charts/2026-08-21/lyv-rsi.png)

![LYV MACD](charts/2026-08-21/lyv-macd.png)

## 3. CTVA — seed & crop-protection, split catalyst (hold, options-led)

**Price:** $79.46 close / $80.50 pre-market (+1.3%) | RSI(14): 48.0 | MACD histogram: +0.06
**Valuation:** Market cap $53.0B | PE 52.5× | P/B 2.1× | Div yield 0.9% | 52w range $60.54–$90.97 (high Jul 29)
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 18 ref / 52W high):** Bear $60.56 | Base $78.07 | Bull $90.51
**Thesis:** Seed pricing and crop-protection productivity into the September investor days and October Vylor spin — two investable companies without operational disruption or stranded costs.
**Holdings:** 50× Sep 18 '26 $85 calls @ $0.385 (mark $0.50, IV 24.2%, delta 0.18, break-even $85.50) + 1 sh tracker @ $77.79. Still the largest **long** exposure sleeve (~68%).

**Catalyst:** September investor days + October Vylor spin · ex-div Sep 1 · **option expiry Sep 18 — 28 DTE, theta is the clock**

![CTVA MACD](charts/2026-08-21/ctva-macd.png)

![PAYX MACD](charts/2026-08-21/payx-macd.png)

## 5. TOST — restaurant OS / payments (new real short, put-protected)

**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 18 ref / 52W high):** Bear $22.33 | Base $35.44 | Bull $45.10
**Thesis (short):** Location/GPV growth and AI products are priced for perfection at 45×; weaker restaurant demand, payments compression, or hardware/support costs can re-rate the multiple.
**Holdings:** Short **100 sh** @ $35.13 (was 1-sh token) + 10× Jan '27 $32 puts @ $2.27 (mark $2.26, IV 45.8%, delta −0.30, break-even $29.74).

**Catalyst:** Q3 earnings — early Nov (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch (short risk):** RSI 65 with only mild MACD fade — still a momentum name. Upside to bull ref $45.10 = −28%; put floor $32 caps the structure.

![TOST RSI](charts/2026-08-21/tost-rsi.png)

![TOST MACD](charts/2026-08-21/tost-macd.png)

## 6. AVAV — defense autonomy / unmanned systems (new sized long)

**Price:** $159.79 close / $162.24 pre-market (+1.5%) | RSI(14): 44.0 | MACD histogram: −1.30
**Valuation:** Market cap $8.1B | PE n/m (loss) | P/B 1.8× | 52w range $135.20–$417.86
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 20 close / 52W high):** Bear $136.68 | Base $159.79 | Bull $409.83
**Thesis:** BlueHalo integration, funded orders, and supply-chain execution must turn fiscal 2026's acquisition-led scale into durable organic growth, margins, and cash flow.
**Holdings:** **30 sh** @ $162.69 (was 1-sh tracker — first real equity long sleeve outside FRMI).
**Latest:** Stocktwits: overnight bid on Greece counter-drone venture (Aug 21); Stock Titan: Greece venture expected to build drones by 2028 (Aug 20); simplywall.st: "reasonable on its 70% 3-year run" (Aug 21). Close was weak (−5% zone earlier in week) with pre-market bounce.
**Catalyst:** Next earnings / funded-order updates (watch backlog conversion)
**Kill watch:** RSI 44 + deeply negative MACD hist (−1.30) = still digesting. Price sits on base ref $159.79. Kill: sustained break of $136.68 (52W/ref low) or backlog conversion stalling.
**Action:** Hold — new size, weak technicals, constructive Europe headline. Base is the line; no chase above $170 until MACD stabilizes.

![AVAV RSI](charts/2026-08-21/avav-rsi.png)

![AVAV MACD](charts/2026-08-21/avav-macd.png)

**Price:** $5.97 close / $5.98 pre-market | RSI(14): 45.3 | MACD histogram: −0.03
**Valuation:** Market cap $3.83B | P/B 3.7× | Pre-revenue | 52w range $4.47–$36.99
**Entry levels (52W low / cost basis / call-strike refs):** Bear $4.47 | Base $7.26 | Bull $15.00
**Thesis:** Project Matador becoming a scarce, gigawatt-scale powered AI campus near Amarillo. Commercial agreements and funded delivery — not headline capacity — must validate it.
**Holdings:** 500 sh @ $6.56 (−9%) + 10× Dec '28 $10 calls @ $3.676 (mark $2.85, IV 103%, delta 0.70, break-even $12.85).
**Latest:** Stocktwits: best single-day gains / cofounder says market "clearly wants this" (Aug 20) — lease narrative still the driver; Yahoo: "may already be fully priced on its $6.5B lease" (Aug 13).
**Catalyst:** Additional lease/power agreements; construction milestones at Amarillo.
**Kill watch:** Price 18% below base $7.26; bear ref $4.47 is −25%. RSI 45, MACD flat. First lease is necessary, not sufficient; IV 103% keeps calls violent.
**Action:** Hold — binary thesis intact; $4.47 remains the hard line.

![FRMI RSI](charts/2026-08-21/frmi-rsi.png)

![FRMI MACD](charts/2026-08-21/frmi-macd.png)

## 8. MOS — fertilizer cycle (new, short-dated calls — clock is loud)

**Price:** $23.35 close / $23.52 pre-market (+0.7%) | RSI(14): 57.4 | MACD histogram: −0.05
**Valuation:** Market cap $7.4B | PE n/m (loss) | P/B 0.62× | Div yield 4.0% | 52w range $19.80–$37.00
**Entry levels (1Y low / Aug 12 close / 1Y high):** Bear $19.82 | Base $22.60 | Bull $31.04
**Thesis:** Fertilizer-cycle recovery, not clean momentum. Reduced phosphate output, lower costs, and $1.2B capex guidance must translate into better cash generation before conviction rises.
**Holdings:** **10× Sep 4 '26 $24 calls** @ $0.523 (mark $0.58, IV 45.7%, delta 0.40, break-even $24.58) + 1 sh tracker @ $23.18. **Only 14 DTE.**
**Latest:** GuruFocus: +5% and "still undervalued" (Aug 20); Tejara Capital new position (Aug 21); $2B debt offering completed (Aug 18).
**Catalyst:** Near-term tape / fertilizer prints · **option expiry Sep 4 — 14 DTE**
**Kill watch:** Calls need a fast move through $24.58. Price is above base $22.60 but only ~1% under strike. Worst theta clock in the long book after CTVA.
**Action:** Hold/watch tightly — this is a short-dated catalyst lottery, not a core sleeve. No roll without fresh evidence.

![MOS RSI](charts/2026-08-21/mos-rsi.png)

![MOS MACD](charts/2026-08-21/mos-macd.png)

## Mini-book (trackers, shorts, watch)

- **LULU** — 1 sh @ $115.09 (new tracker). Close $115.69 / pre $116.94. Brand/margin recovery thesis; refs $105.43 / $115.69 / $215.88.
- **SBUX** — short 1 sh @ $103.44 (new tracker). Close $103.99 / pre $104.28. Turnaround-expectations short; refs $76.51 / $103.99 / $107.93 — sitting near 52W high zone.
- **BOT** — 1 sh @ $32.67. Close $28.41 / pre $28.97 (+2.0%). Premium-to-NAV deflation is the whole story; Aug 30 NAV checkpoint.
- **Closed/gone from book:** BRBR (calls + tracker fully out), DJT tracker, AAON, HIMS/FIGR/OSCR, NKE, URNM, WAY.
- **Watch only:** XLE energy thesis still de-minimis on the desk.

## Risk/Reward ranking (reference levels; longs ranked upside-to-bull ÷ downside-to-bear)

| Rank | Ticker | Side | Price | Bear | Base | Bull | Ref R/R | Note |
|------|--------|------|-------|------|------|------|---------|------|
| 1 | AVAV | long | $162.24 | $136.68 | $159.79 | $409.83 | ~9.8×* | *Bull is stale 52W high — scenario, not target; MACD weak |
| 2 | FRMI | long | $5.98 | $4.47 | $7.26 | $15.00 | ~6.0× | Lease proof live; binary; IV 103% |
| 3 | MOS | long (calls) | $23.52 | $19.82 | $22.60 | $31.04 | ~2.0× | 14-DTE $24C — lottery ticket |
| 4 | CTVA | long (calls) | $80.50 | $60.56 | $78.07 | $90.51 | ~0.5× | Worst ref R/R; Vylor $1.1B bond = progress; 28 DTE |
| S1 | DASH | short+puts | $223.87 | $146.60 | $215.79 | $281.74 | squeeze risk | RSI 69; now −150 sh + 14× $200P |
| S2 | TOST | short+puts | $35.29 | $22.33 | $35.44 | $45.10 | squeeze risk | RSI 65; newly real −100 sh |
| S3 | LYV | short+puts | $181.90 | $125.61 | $180.74 | $188.46 | tight squeeze | 4% from 52W high; 12× $165P |
| S4 | PAYX | short+puts | $123.05 | $83.61 | $119.93 | $134.87 | +10% squeeze cost | RSI 62 + MACD divergence; $105P |

**Gemini risk notes (Aug 21):**
- ⚠️ **Dominant book risk is the short stack** — DASH (−150) + LYV (−100) + TOST (−100) + PAYX (−75) = −425 short shares against a $106K account. Net delta −133% is a different regime than yesterday's −36%.
- ⚠️ DASH (RSI 69) and TOST (RSI 65) are fighting strong momentum; squeeze path is the primary gap risk into the open.
- ⚠️ Negative-theta concentration: MOS 14-DTE calls + CTVA 28-DTE calls are pure time decay if catalysts slip.
- ⚠️ FRMI remains the binary long tail — one adverse AI-campus headline reprices the LEAPs violently at IV 103%.

**Engine risk note:** Prior split (GPT 6 / Grok 4 / Fable 8) argued open-but-sized. Overnight the book abandoned "sized" and went full short-structure: 120% cash, −133% net delta, every large short put-capped. The disagreement hedge is no longer a stance — it is the portfolio.

*Levels are market references (52W/1Y low · recent close · 52W/1Y high), not intrinsic-value DCFs; confidence low pending refreshed net-DCF work. Catalyst dates unconfirmed except where noted.*
